Telegram bot starter: aiogram 3, Django 5, Celery; minimal `/start` and user tracking. Extend for actual bots.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

`.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` required; `CELERY_BROKER_URL` (Redis), `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`.

`main.py` initializes Django ORM, configures aiogram Bot/Dispatcher, registers middleware/routes, starts polling. `config/`: Django settings, dj-database-url (SQLite default), Celery, admin. `bot/`: `models.py` TelegramUser; `aiogram/handlers.py` `/start`; `aiogram/middlewares.py` UserTrackingMiddleware; `tasks.py` placeholder. Middleware tracks interactions in Django. DB operations use Django sync-to-async.

Add handlers to `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or router modules included in `main.py:42`. Add models to `bot/models.py`, register in `bot/admin.py`; tasks to `bot/tasks.py` using the `<REDACTED_USER>_task` decorator. Add env vars to `.env.example`; access via `config/settings.py`.

Uses `uv` for dependency management - all commands should be run with `uv run python`
Django admin at `/admin`; DB configurable via `DATABASE_URL`. Celery needs Redis running. Production-ready; configure secrets and database.
